notes: TROOP 0.4.2 fixes the Moon touchdown movement lock. The lunar landing pad now has reliable capsule contact, the Moon runs in a precision-safe coordinate band, and low-gravity ground recovery uses an appropriate collision margin. Touchdown also reapplies the on-foot collider after the final teleport and restores captured gameplay input, so W/A/S/D works as soon as the voyage camera returns. The regression gate now drives a real monkey from the rocket across the pad and onto generated lunar terrain. Protocol v9 keeps the revised Moon coordinates authoritative in multiplayer. Because the multiplayer protocol and project settings changed, Windows players must run the 0.4.2 installer once.
